definitions.correction_recheck_cycle: An actual correction followed by a relevant check. Reruns without another correction, model turns and assertions are not extra cycles.
definitions.expected_negative: A deliberately rejected invalid/unauthorized operation asserted by a passing test is not a product bug.
definitions.final_defect_state: No outstanding observed finding after accepted audit means only that recorded scope found none. There is no oracle for latent bugs.
definitions.product_defect: An evidenced required-behavior violation, grouped by root cause. Repeated symptoms and assertions do not add defects.
definitions.source_refs: All evidence paths are relative to the benchmark root; line numbers are one-based.

limitations: Counts describe observed and recorded work, not all defects present at any moment or a bug-free guarantee.
Builder issue logs and independent reproductions have different evidence strengths; unaccepted metadata never becomes canonical PASS/FAIL merely because app checks ran.
Auth/signing runtime credentials were excluded from this evidence review; no secret contents were read.
Controller formatter/inventory/environment interruptions are benchmark methodology events, not app product defects. Their time and usage remain costs.
Visual refinements are separate from product defects, with the objective contrast ambiguity explicitly disclosed.
No causal conclusion, winner claim, production security certification, exhaustive accessibility assertion or live provider verification follows from this classification.

Final raw reports have zero findings; this is not an oracle for latent bugs. Adaptive canonical acceptance remains pending solely on report metadata at this capture. Root may update acceptance-only state after disposition without altering product/cycle counts.
scope: Evidence classification of recorded ServiceFlow implementation and repair iterations. The review used frozen native app source/audit captures; it did not run additional app tests, alter measured apps or feed unrecorded findings to subjects.
